lines.text: Moses sends a thousand men from each tribe to war, with Phinehas son of Eleazar carrying the trumpets.
The Israelites kill every male of Midian, including five kings and Balaam son of Beor, with the sword.
The Israelites burn the Midianite cities, then bring the captives to Moses on the plains of Moab, by the Jordan across from Bethel.
Moses is angry with the officers and says the women caused Israel's unfaithfulness at Peor through the counsel of Balak.
The commanders offer gold to make atonement, and Moses and Eleazar bring it into the Tent of Meeting.
